# Empowr Heroes

> Empowr Heroes is the fundraising and donation platform for Empowr CIC, enabling individuals and organisations to support community programmes through direct giving.

Empowr Heroes provides a transparent, mission-aligned giving experience — connecting donors to the real impact of Empowr CIC's work in education, employment, and community empowerment. Supporters choose a monthly Hero tier or make a one-off contribution; every donation directly funds experiential learning programmes that create opportunity for people in underserved communities.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://hero.empowrcic.org): Empowr's mission, why experiential learning matters, and what supporter contributions make possible
- [Become a Hero](https://hero.empowrcic.org/become): Choose a Hero tier and give — the main donation page
- [Hero Tiers](https://hero.empowrcic.org/tiers): Side-by-side comparison of every giving level and its impact
- [Founding Patron](https://hero.empowrcic.org/patron): Transformational giving programme (£100,000+ annual or multi-year commitment, by enquiry)
- [Why Experiential Learning](https://hero.empowrcic.org/why-experiential-learning): The evidence and reasoning behind Empowr's approach

## Giving Levels

- Seed Hero — £10/month: keeps sessions affordable and accessible
- Momentum Hero — £25/month: funds the infrastructure behind consistent sessions
- Community Hero — £50/month: expands reach into new venues, schools and communities
- Champion Hero — £250/month: drives sustainability and strategic development
- Legacy Hero — £500/month: enables ambitious, long-term growth with stability
- One-Time Hero — any amount: a one-off contribution of the supporter's choosing

## About

Empowr Heroes is operated by Empowr CIC (empowrcic.org), a UK-based Community Interest Company. All funds raised through Empowr Heroes support Empowr CIC's community programmes.
